screens_reviewed: Three scroll captures (top / mid / end) of app/reports/[submissionId].tsx in light theme: report overview header + Submission details/Context panels, the per-section score chart and Score results table, and the comments column ending at the sticky Share / Back to My Audits footer.
verdict: A dense, well-organized read-only report screen that renders cleanly on iPhone: native stack header with truncating place title, single-column stacked cards, and a sticky two-button footer that respects the home-indicator inset. The main weaknesses are systemic rather than visual — the screen bypasses the app's shared ScaledText/useDesignSystem layer, so it ignores both the accessibility font-scale preference and dark theme, and it hand-rolls every card instead of using design-system primitives.

critical_issues.issue: The screen imports Text and Paragraph directly from "tamagui" (line 18) and hard-codes numeric fontSize values (30, 28, 24, 20, 18, 15, 14, 13, 12). The app ships ScaledText/ScaledParagraph specifically to multiply explicit numeric fontSize/lineHeight by the auditor's stored fontScale preference. Because this route does not use them, the entire report is immune to the text-size accessibility setting — a real problem for a data-dense report meant to be read in the field.
critical_issues.evidence: app/reports/[submissionId].tsx:18 (import { Button, Paragraph, Spinner, Text, XStack, YStack } from "tamagui") and e.g. fontSize={30} at line 266; contrast with components/ui/ScaledText.tsx:2295 scaleSize(fontSize, fontScale)
critical_issues.fix: Replace the tamagui Text/Paragraph imports with `import { ScaledParagraph as Paragraph, ScaledText as Text } from "components/ui/ScaledText"` as the other screens do (see ScreenHeader.tsx:2330), so the existing numeric sizes scale with the preference.

critical_issues.issue: The route imports the static `designSystem` (light-only token set) at module scope and reads designSystem.colors.* everywhere instead of the live useDesignSystem() hook. getDesignSystem() returns darkColors when theme === "dark"; by binding to the static export this screen will keep rendering light surfaces/foreground even in dark mode, producing a light report on a dark app shell (the native header IS theme-aware via useYeeStackHeaderOptions, so the mismatch is visible at the header seam).
critical_issues.evidence: app/reports/[submissionId].tsx:19 import { designSystem } from "lib/design-system"; lib/design-system.ts:453 designSystem = { colors: lightColors, ... } vs useDesignSystem() at 501
critical_issues.fix: Use `const designSystem = useDesignSystem()` inside the component (and thread it / a context into the module-level child components) instead of importing the static light token set, matching the pattern in app/_layout.tsx and (tabs)/_layout.tsx.

improvements.location: app/reports/[submissionId].tsx Card / InfoPanel / MetricCard / CommentBlock / ScreenHeader-like overview
improvements.suggestion: design_system_components_used is (none): every surface (Card, InfoPanel, MetricCard, the 'Report overview' heading block) is a bespoke YStack with inline radii/border/shadow rather than the shared ui/* primitives (e.g. ScreenHeader for the title+subtitle, a shared Card). This duplicates styling and is the root cause of the font-scale and dark-theme drift above. Consolidating onto the shared components would fix both consistency and the theming gaps in one move.
improvements.evidence: review/packs/reports-submissionId.md line 4 (design_system_components_used: (none)); local Card at app/reports/[submissionId].tsx:862, ScreenHeader exists in core.md:2325

improvements.suggestion: The Weather value renders as a raw comma-joined string ('feels-hot,rainy-drizzling') with no space after the comma and lowercase hyphenated tokens, which reads as machine data in an otherwise polished report. Format getReadableWeather output with ', ' separators and title-case for human legibility.
improvements.evidence: screenshot 17-report-detail-top.png Weather row; value from getReadableWeather (app/reports/[submissionId].tsx:400)

improvements.suggestion: The 'Submitted at' row value reads 'Submitted Jun 28 at 5:02 PM', repeating the word the label already states. Strip the leading 'Submitted ' from getSubmissionTimestampLabel for this context so the right-aligned value is just the date/time.

tamagui_notes: Spacing on this screen mixes Tamagui space tokens (gap="$3", p="$4", py="$2.5") with raw pixels (fontSize numbers, ImportanceMeter width={22}/height={8}, ChartBar height={14}). That is acceptable for fixed graphical elements but the typography pixels should flow through ScaledText (see critical issue) — file: app/reports/[submissionId].tsx:262-823.

ScrollView contentContainerStyle uses getResponsiveContentContainerStyle without topInset; this is correct here because the native stack header (headerShown:true at app/_layout.tsx:1386) owns the notch inset, so content does not need an additional topInset.

Footer is an absolute YStack with paddingBottom: insets.bottom + 12 (app/reports/[submissionId].tsx:464) and bottomPadding is reserved in the scroll container via footerHeight measurement (line 258) — content clears the sticky bar correctly.
platform_notes: Safe area: home-indicator inset is handled (insets.bottom + 12 on the sticky footer); top notch/Dynamic Island is handled by the native stack header. No safe-area issue observed across the three captures.
Thumb reach: the two primary actions (Share, Back to My Audits) are pinned to a bottom sticky bar within easy thumb reach, equal flex width — good iPhone ergonomics.

Compact fit: InfoPanel minWidth 280 and CommentBlock minWidth 250 inside flexWrap XStacks collapse to a single column at the ~360pt phone width (verified in images 1 and 3), so the two-up panel layout degrades gracefully on iPhone.
not_assessable: Dark-theme rendering is inferred from the static-token import; no dark screenshot was provided to confirm the visual mismatch.
Exact WCAG contrast ratios for mutedForeground (#6B706F) body text on surface/background were not measured; the pairing looks plausibly AA for body but was not numerically verified.
Loading and offline/error states (Spinner, 'Report unavailable offline' Card, Pending upload Card) are not shown in these captures.
Pending-upload and tablet two-column variants are not exercised by these iPhone light screenshots.
score_rationale: Usable and visually clean on iPhone with correct safe-area and footer ergonomics (would otherwise sit at 7-8), but two clear systemic problems pull it to 6: it ignores the accessibility font-scale preference and the dark theme by bypassing ScaledText/useDesignSystem, and it uses none of the shared design-system primitives, duplicating styling. These are real, code-verified defects rather than cosmetic polish.
